'''Miech Conar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served as a commanding officer of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|escort frigate]] ''[[New Star]]''. Conar was an intelligent, competent officer who was loyal to the Empire, however he did not wish to [[Death/Legends|die]] in a pointless battle. When Conar and the ''New Star'' were assigned to defend a convoy heading from the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], he fell victim to a trap laid by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|Privateer]] vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]''. His ship and the convoy were both captured.<ref name="HS" />
